descriptions.d31j_build_material_image_grid_80170bac: Creates the image and names it from the path; loads the texture through the loader, reporting failure through discarded string copies; creates the material with wrap mode by option bit 128; adds three blocks; marks the selected material and applies it; stores the texture size, derives cell size or cell count by option bit 32, fills UV and step arrays row by row; sets the loaded flag, applies three option setters and the texture options unless bit 256 is set.
